auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion on Deferred Tax Assets (net) of Rs 10,670 lakhs recognized primarily towards unused business losses; auditor draws attention to Note 10.2 of Consolidated Financial Statements regarding recognition of DTA

key_risks: Macroeconomic and geopolitical uncertainties impacting infrastructure investments and demand visibility
Regulatory challenges including stricter emission norms, safety standards, and quality certifications increasing manufacturing and operating costs
Competitive intensity from global OEMs and lower-cost imports exerting pressure on pricing and margins
Skilled workforce constraints for operations, maintenance, and servicing of technologically advanced equipment
Execution risks across large infrastructure projects despite improved order book visibility
Fluctuations in input costs (steel, critical components) impacting margins if not managed through pricing and cost optimization
Currency volatility influencing input costs due to dependence on imported components
Interest rate changes affecting borrowing costs and profitability
Cybersecurity and data protection risks associated with digitalization

latest_guidance.statement: In the next two years, TIL aims to launch 5-6 new product ranges for the non-defence sector
Revenue target of INR800-1,000 crores over next 3-4 years with current fixed cost base plus INR24-25 crores capex
Targeting defence orders of approximately Rs 2,000 crore over the medium term
Profitable growth journey expected to be steep from now onwards due to foundational steps underway
Unused business losses will be adjusted against taxable profits expected within the specified period
